name: megomaged/claude-motion-studio
description: A motion studio skill that builds motion from scratch, never copying another skill's or repo's code or text, with every report claim drawn from evidence. It supports Remotion, HTML/GSAP, and SVG motion work.
install: download the repository (Code, Download ZIP), unzip it, copy the folder into ~/.claude/skills/ (every project) or <project>/.claude/skills/ (one project), named claude-motion-studio. Do not invent a skills-add command; use the download-and-copy route.
